authority.scope_rule: Literal criterion only; full release Visual Bars A/B remain separately OPEN. Reuse relevant captures without recapture.

scope: Readability of the provided opening destinations and visible trainer presence at them during the retained Low Compatibility native 1280x720 night route. Actual movement/input, collision reachability and completeness of the opening-NPC census are not inferred from stills.

evidence.native_review_reused: This same judge previously inspected selected original native frames, including 013, 030, 031, 043, 047, 061, 064, 070, 071, 072, 091 and 096. All four complete contact sheets were re-inspected for this scoped judgment.

These frames do not remove the required readable destination witness or demonstrate a failure to reach it. They do not establish that the obstruction is harmless in continuous play.

concrete_occlusions_retained.literal_scope_assessment: This remains a real obstruction. The central trainer and forward path remain visible; 042 preserves Maren's reached stand and 044-047 preserve the following Oskar approach/stand. camp_prompt_assessment: The previously noted missing camp prompt in 071-072 is not a missing reach witness. The illuminated camp and trainer beside it are visible. No camp interaction or functional success is claimed.

behavioral_limit.reason: Controller glyphs and visible endpoint positions do not establish normal-controller traversal, collision paths, absence of developer repositioning, functional interactions or a complete opening-target census. Those require the retained actual-path/input evidence outside this visual judgment. No gameplay trace or game source was inspected here.

full_visual_bar.reason: The retained art, material, camp-flame, lighting-depth and camera-defect observations remain available for the full visual work. No full Bar A/B, region, day/weather/fight, device or High/Medium certification is issued or used as a gate for this literal scoped visual judgment.

method: Same frames, same retained judge, no source/change narrative, no engine execution and no recapture. Only scope-verdict-f01-3.json was written for this reassessment.
